svg.title: TOPAK H2 — The decision records, ADR-0001 to ADR-0077, by area
svg.desc: Every record with its status and confirmation markers at G12 and Batch 40 (2026.11.17), and its amendments since G9, pending ones in amber. Solid blue edges are dependencies taken from each record's "Depends on" line, drawn where both records sit in the same row of tiles (every tile lists its full line); the grey edge is the one supersession; red dashed edges are the reversals in effect (ToO §8.3) and ADR-0040's. The twenty-two records drafted after G11 are the two lowest bands, every one Proposed and none in force.

Tile colour is status: blue Accepted (genesis), red Accepted with a confirmation marker (C1–C4, ADR-0029
§4), dashed blue Accepted · provisional (ADR-0029 A4: in force, subject to redesign, confirmation
required), amber Proposed, grey superseded, tombstone or reserved.
"bootstrap set": ADR-0024 to 0027, which cannot carry a marker (ADR-0029 §4); three of them hold a
provisional amendment, which the genesis attestation must name (G11 §1.2); ADR-0024 A4 is pending.
"§1–§5, §7, §8": ratified in part; ADR-0022 §6 stays Proposed. ADR-0042 is whole since Batch 30.

ratification. ADR-0059 to 0068 are an overlay, not the archetype: a deployment with one plane takes nothing

A18, ADR-0045 A5, ADR-0053 A1), none in force (G12 §1.1, §6).
